evals.prompt: I changed sections/product-main.liquid. The Shopify theme dev server should already be running for this repo. Check the current Chrome tab and verify the price block now has data-sale-badge=true.
evals.expected_output: The existing watcher, Chrome profile, browser session, and matching tab are reused through Playwright CLI when it is available; the remote development-theme ID is verified; and the requested DOM change is checked without opening localhost or another browser instance.
assertions: The agent confirms the watcher working directory before reusing it
The agent does not restart an existing watcher for the same theme
The agent uses a myshopify.com preview_theme_id URL rather than localhost
The agent prefers Playwright CLI when available and verifies window.Shopify.theme.id before trusting the tab
The agent reuses the existing Chrome profile, browser session, and matching tab rather than launching an isolated browser
The agent checks the requested data-sale-badge DOM state and reports evidence

evals.prompt: Open this theme in Chrome and make sure the announcement bar renders. There's no dev server yet. shopify.theme.toml has default and staging environments; use the usual local setup and don't expose any credentials.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks whether to use the default or staging environment before starting the watcher and does not expose credentials or claim that the announcement bar was verified.
assertions: The agent asks the user to choose between environments.default and environments.staging
The agent does not assume that environments.default is the intended environment
The agent does not start shopify theme dev before the user selects an environment
The agent does not print credentials or secret files
The agent does not claim that the announcement bar was verified

evals.prompt: Can you start theme dev here and show me the cart drawer? Port 9292 is already used by another Shopify theme under ../client-b.
evals.expected_output: The other theme watcher is identified by working directory and left untouched while this theme starts on a verified free local port and is checked through its remote preview URL.
assertions: The agent resolves the process working directory instead of assuming the port belongs to this theme
The agent does not kill or restart the other theme watcher
The agent selects a verified free local port without asking to stop the other watcher
The agent does not fall back to browser verification through localhost
The agent does not claim the cart drawer was verified while the conflict is unresolved

evals.prompt: Verify this theme preview in my current Chrome. Playwright CLI, Chrome DevTools CLI, and Chrome DevTools MCP are all available.
evals.expected_output: Playwright CLI is selected and attached to the existing Chrome profile; the available alternatives are not connected; and the existing preview tab is reused.
assertions: The agent detects and selects the playwright-cli command ahead of every other available browser tool
The agent does not connect Chrome DevTools CLI or MCP at the same time
The agent uses the already-running Chrome and current profile
The agent reuses the existing preview tab instead of opening another browser, window, or isolated context

evals.prompt: Check the current Shopify preview tab. Playwright is unavailable, but a browser CLI and a browser MCP are available.
evals.expected_output: The available browser CLI is selected instead of MCP and is attached to the existing Chrome profile without launching an isolated browser.
assertions: The agent selects the available browser CLI because Playwright CLI is unavailable
The agent does not select or connect the available MCP
The agent reuses the existing Chrome profile, browser session, and preview tab
The agent does not launch another browser, window, profile, or isolated context

evals.prompt: Please verify the current theme preview. No browser CLI is installed, but Chrome DevTools MCP and Playwright MCP are available.
evals.expected_output: No MCP is connected automatically. The existing Chrome state is preserved while the agent explains that MCP is the discouraged fallback and asks the user which available tool to use.
assertions: The agent does not connect either MCP before receiving the user's choice
The agent states that MCP is a discouraged fallback because no browser CLI is available
The agent asks the user which available MCP or alternative to use
The agent does not launch another browser, window, profile, or isolated context
The agent does not claim that the preview was verified
